definition: The design, development and management of sustainable agroecosystems based on the application of ecological principles while considering existing social, cultural, and economic factors of farming communities. (From https://lod.nal.usda.gov/nalt/5505)
name: Agroecology

definition: Eating behaviors that are subclinical or milder forms of EATING DISORDERS such as unhealthy dieting, binge eating, and purging.
name: Disordered Eating Behavior

definition: Computational designs that apply DEEP LEARNING methods on extremely large data sets as a basis for predicting and constructing natural-sounding text.
name: Large Language Models

definition: Ready-to-eat foods and beverages prepared and/or sold by vendors or hawkers especially in the streets and other similar places. They represent a significant part of urban food consumption for millions of low-and-middle-income consumers, in urban areas on a daily basis. (USDA)
name: Street Food

definition: Trials in which participants are intentionally challenged (whether or not they have been vaccinated) with exposure to an infectious disease organism.
name: Human Challenge Trials

definition: A method of training machine learning models whereby multiple devices train their own copy of the artificial intelligence model using decentralized local data. These locally trained model results are then aggregated by a central server to update the global model without accessing local data.
name: Federated Learning

aliases: Deep Learning Based Object Detection Algorithms
definition: Algorithms designed to find or localize the objects in images and assign the objects (affordances).
name: Detection Algorithms

definition: Algorithms that can execute several instructions simultaneously on different processing devices and then combine all the individual outputs to produce the final result.
name: Parallel Algorithms

definition: A class of algorithms which are designed to forecast unseen data. Prediction Algorithms can discover patterns, perform classification tasks, and identify trends.
name: Prediction Algorithms

definition: Persistent and irrational fear of enclosed places (e.g., elevators, closets, tunnels) or of being confined (e.g., in an airplane or the backseat of a car). Situations where enclosure or confinement may be encountered are often avoided or else endured with intense anxiety or distress. The focus of fear is typically on panic symptoms triggered in these situations, such as feelings of being unable to breathe, choking, sweating, and fears of losing control. (From APA Dictionary of Psychology, accessed 11/8/2023)
name: Claustrophobia

definition: Situations in which two moral principles conflict with one another. Fictional or hypothetical dilemmas of this kind are used to assess the moral beliefs or moral reasoning skills of individuals. (From APA Dictionary of Psychology, https://dictionary.apa.org/)
name: Ethical Dilemmas

definition: A non-invasive technique for measuring changes within the tumor MICROVASCULATURE.
name: Dynamic Contrast Enhanced Magnetic Resonance Imaging

definition: A genus of the family Calliphoridae in the order Diptera. Members include common green bottle fly whose maggots are used in MAGGOT THERAPY and sheep blowflies causing MYIASIS. Several member species are blowflies of interest to FORENSIC ENTOMOLOGY.
name: Lucilia Blowflies

definition: A secreted protein containing four LEUCINE-rich repeats, followed by six EGF repeats, an ALPS domain, three additional EGF repeats, and a CYSTEINE-rich carboxy-terminal region. It functions in CELL MIGRATION and neuron guidance during brain and nervous system development.
name: Slit Homolog 2 Protein

definition: A systematic training calendar designed to provide variations in performance targeting, while maximizing results and reducing the potential for overtraining. Term only applies to EXERCISE.
name: Periodization

definition: A form of disulfide stress-induced CELL DEATH triggered under glucose starvation conditions and overexpression of AMINO ACID TRANSPORT SYSTEM Y+ proteins.
name: Disulfidptosis

definition: Debt related to, in whole or in part, transactions, accounts, or balances arising from the receipt of medical services, products, or devices.
name: Medical Debt

definition: A mitochondrial protein found in the ADRENAL GLANDS and GONADS. It plays an important role in the transfer of cholesterol from the outer to the inner mitochondrial membrane.
name: Steroidogenic Acute Regulatory Protein

definition: An arrhythmogenic disorder of the heart characterized by irregular heart rhythms in response to physical activity, stress, or catecholamine infusion, often transitioning into VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION.
name: Polymorphic Catecholaminergic Ventricular Tachycardia

definition: A glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor and Glucose-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist to enhance glycemic control in adults with TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS.
name: Tirzepatide

definition: A form of EUROPEAN FOOTBALL derived from traditional Irish ball games. It has similarities to, but is distinct from, SOCCER and RUGBY.
name: Gaelic Football

definition: Forced labor occurs when individuals are compelled against their will to provide work or service through the use of force, fraud, or coercion. (https://www.dhs.gov/blue-campaign/forced-labor)
name: Forced Labor, Employment

definition: The use of engineered small molecules to manipulate the activity of specific cells within living organisms, typically. Chemogenetic techniques are often used to study specific neural activity through genetically engineered receptors that bind specific endogenous or exogenous ligands.
name: Chemogenetics

definition: Acute often necrotizing pyelonephritis characterized by accumulation of gas within and around renal parenchyma. Emphysematous pyelonephritis is typically associated with bacterial infection in DIABETES MELLITUS and IMMUNOCOMPROMISED PATIENT.
name: Emphysematous Pyelonephritis

definition: A genetic engineering technique that involves manipulating the EPIGENOME at the target region with minimal or no modification of the genomic DNA.
name: Epigenome Editing

definition: Injuries to RNA molecules, leading to changes in their structure or function.
name: RNA Damage

definition: A therapeutic intervention designed to treat people with DEPRESSION through use of elements of MINDFULNESS-BASED STRESS REDUCTION and other cognitive behavioral therapy.
name: Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy

definition: Believed or anticipated consequences of a person’s behavior.
name: Outcome Expectations

definition: Sitting or walking in a FOREST or forested area and taking in all of the environmental stimuli of the forest - the sounds, images, atmopheric conditions, etc. as a form of therapy.
name: Forest Therapy

definition: Lipid mediators derived from derivatives of POLYUNSATURATED FATTY ACIDS which tends to limit inflammation. They include resolvins, PROTECTIN, maresins, and LIPOXINS.
name: Specialized Pro-Resolving Mediators

definition: Establishments that are open at night and which provide food and drinks, and entertainment such as music, dancing, singing, and comedy acts.
name: Nightclubs

definition: a combination of deutivacaftor, a CFTR potentiator, tezacaftor, and vanzacaftor indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 6 years and older who have at least one F508del mutation or another responsive mutation in the CFTR gene.
name: deutivacaftor, tezacaftor , vanzacaftor

definition: A subtype of INFLUENZA A VIRUS comprised of the surface proteins hemagglutinin (VIRAL HEMAGGLUTININ) 5 and neuraminidase (NA PROTEIN, INFLUENZA A VIRUS) 5.
name: Influenza A virus, H5N5 subtype

definition: A subtype of INFLUENZA A VIRUS comprised of the surface proteins hemagglutinin (VIRAL HEMAGGLUTININ) 7 and neuraminidase (NA PROTEIN, INFLUENZA A VIRUS) 8.
name: Influenza A virus, H7N8 subtype

definition: small-interfering RNA that targets ANGPTL3
name: zodasiran
